newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort up one point to 11.0.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort up one point to 11.0.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News index of consumer comfort rose one point to 11.0 in the week ended July 13 from the prior week.
The survey polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, personal finances and their willingness to spend.

Respondents' confidence in the economy remained unchanged at 14. Confidence in personal finances rose to 26 from 24, while the rating of buying climate gained two points to -6 from -8 in the prior week.
Regionally, confidence rose in the West and Midwest, while holding steady in the Northeast, but attitudes fell in the South.
The current poll has a margin error of plus or minus 3.5 percentage points.
